systems.role: spatial memory interface and V1-V10 release spine
creative production and studio handoff dependency

rules: Do not collapse ecosystem state into one repo status.
Classify external dependencies separately from core runtime safety.
Asset pending is not the same as product broken.
Every ecosystem decision must produce auditable evidence.
The deferred-asset-lane and deferred-studio-handoff IDs are retained for compatibility; they identify discovered Asset Factory and Studio sources, not missing repositories.
Repository discovery and file presence do not establish live provider or consumer integration acceptance.
A complete source inventory remains acceptance-unverified; only the existing independent release governance can authorize shipping for an exact release SHA.
scope: Spatial V9 source dependency registry; not the complete Holdings estate register
